question: A material has magnetic susceptibility $\chi=4.0\times10^{-5}$. If it is placed in a magnetising field of intensity $2.0\times10^{4}\,\text{A m}^{-1}$, calculate the magnetisation produced in it.

options.D: For a linear material, $M=\chi H=(4.0\times10^{-5})(2.0\times10^{4})=8.0\times10^{-1}\,\text{A m}^{-1}=0.8\,\text{A m}^{-1}$.
